notes: The wiki: each tile of distance takes 2.25 chemfuel from each pod's launcher, so a full launcher (150) reaches 66 tiles. RimWorld burns at least 1 chemfuel for any launch (recalled from its code). The wiki gives no flight speed, only 'very quick but not instant': 50 ticks a tile (66 tiles in about 1.3 game hours) is ours. Our world is a square grid: a tile's distance counts a diagonal step as one, as RimWorld's hexagons do.
